snp4.1:1.1: If one, longing for sensual pleasure,
snp4.1:1.4: The mortal gets what he wants.
snp4.1:2.4:
he’s afflicted,
as if shot with an arrow.
snp4.1:3.3:
—as he would, with his foot,
the head of a snake—
snp4.1:3.4:
goes beyond, mindful,
this attachment in the world.
snp4.1:4.2:
for fields, land, gold,
cattle, horses,
snp4.1:4.3:
servants, employees,
women, relatives,
many sensual pleasures,
snp4.1:6.3:
Letting them go,
he’d cross over the flood
snp4.1:6.4:
like one who, having bailed out the boat,
has reached the far shore.
